Noor (IC): Hi team — I need to request Dec 24-26 off for an unexpected caregiver obligation. That's inside the Dec20-27 blackout. I have 4h accrual and 8h carryover but need 24h. What are our options?

Grace (Manager): Sorry to hear that Noor. We can try a blackout exception if coverage is arranged. Can you outline which duties you'd miss (meetings/oncall/tasks) and whether anyone can swap?

Noor (IC): Main impact: docs reviews morning 25th and I own a small pager rotation on the 24th evening. I've asked Pri to cover docs and Sam to take the pager if approved.

PeopleOps Bot: FYI: blackout window Dec 20-27 requires manager approval + People Ops sign-off. Exceptions allowed for urgent caregiver needs but need manager attestation and coverage plan.

Elliot (People Ops): Hi Noor/Grace. Process: 1) Submit a TimeOff request and select "Blackout Exception". 2) Attach manager attestation and coverage plan (named backups). 3) If accruals insufficient you can elect unpaid for the shortfall; mark it as "Unpaid Exception" to flag payroll. We'll review within 48 hours.

Payroll Bot: Note: accruals are deducted first, then carryover. Any unpaid hours must be flagged as "Unpaid Exception" in the TimeOff request for payroll tagging.

Grace (Manager): I can attest: "I confirm coverage is arranged: Pri covers docs review on 25th; Sam covers pager 24th evening. Approving Noor's blackout exception."

Noor (IC): Submitted TimeOff ID 20555533 as 8h PTO + 16h unpaid exception, attached Grace's attestation and coverage notes.

Elliot (People Ops): Received 20555533. We'll fast-track since coverage is named. Quick audit note: please ensure Pri and Sam update the rotation calendar and post handover in #incidents. Approving in the system now.

PeopleOps Bot: Request 20555533 status changed to PENDING REVIEW by People Ops.

Elliot (People Ops): Approved and marked: "Blackout Exception Approved: coverage verified; unpaid portion recorded." Policy ref PTO-3.2. Audit ID EX-2026-36.

Payroll Bot: Noted unpaid hours for TimeOff ID 20555533; payroll feed updated.

Noor (IC): Thank you all — will post handovers now and confirm calendar changes. Much appreciated.

Grace (Manager): Thanks for arranging backups. Get some rest and take care.
